Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP (Cobalt_MAP_v3.pdf) that ties evaluation milestones to procurement checkpoints and includes a commissioning agenda for the deployment decision. High-level summary:

1) Evaluation/Pilot (Week 0–2):
   - Mode: Hosted (US-East) for fastest time-to-value; TLS + prefix caching enabled.
   - Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 300ms for standard prompts, throughput 10 qps sustained, no PHI written to logs.
   - Deliverables: latency report, token-cost analysis, evaluation prompts + output samples.

2) Canary / Production Pilot (Week 3–4):
   - Mode: EU Dedicated pool (if PHI processing required) or Hosted EU with VPC peering as interim.
   - Success criteria: compliance checklist signoff, KMS integration validated, SLA runbook reviewed.

3) Production (Week 5+):
   - Options: Dedicated (preferred for sustained load and data isolation) or Private for air-gapped/regulatory needs.
   - Rollout: canary in one region, gradual ramp to steady state; automatic fallback to Hosted variants in case of capacity events.

Procurement asks: I'll attach a SOC2 checklist and a short onboarding table for the procurement team — we typically need a PO or MSA signature to bind a Dedicated commitment. I'll also include a pricing delta sheet (attached).

Proposed near-term timeline:
- 2027-03-22: technical readiness call (eng + infra)
- 2027-03-29: start Hosted pilot (US-East)
- 2027-04-12: decision point on Dedicated EU (if PHI)

If those dates look OK, I'll push an updated MAP (v4) and a DocuSign envelope for the MSA/redlines.

Attachments: Cobalt_MAP_v3.pdf, pricing_summary_dedicated_vs_hosted.xlsx

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes

- Pricing: procurement wants the incremental cost to move to EU Dedicated from Hosted (monthly run rate with a 12-month commit).

I've attached the procurement note (forwarded below). Can you provide SOC2 evidence and the KMS note, and update the MAP with an EU-first pilot option and the committed pricing? Also include a mutual milestone for procurement approvals so our legal has clarity on dates.
